messages.content: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to convert light energy into chemical energy they can use for fuel. Using chlorophyll in their leaves, plants capture sunlight and use it to transform carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil into glucose (sugar) and oxygen. This is why plants need sunlight to grow and why they release oxygen as a byproduct.
